title: A Survey on Online Aggression: Content Detection and Behavioral Analysis on Social Media

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative analysis of the distribution of online aggression datasets and research studies across various languages to demonstrate the predominant focus on English and the lack of resources for low-resource languages.
Systematic review of literature discussing algorithmic bias, false positive rates across different demographic groups, and the impact of annotator demographics on dataset labeling.
Reviewing literature on cross-cultural differences in the manifestation of online aggression and evaluating the lack of culturally sensitive, cross-cultural aggression detection models.
